title: Repair and build
short: Hand tools, sharpening, home fixes, woodworking, engines, welding, simple structures
intro: A step-by-step learning track for fixing and making things with a modest home or garage workshop. It starts with workshop safety and hand tools, then moves through sharpening, simple home and plumbing repairs, woodworking, small engines, metalwork and building simple structures from plans.

limits.text: If you are not trained to lock out and tag out a machine, do not clear jams or debris inside it yourself; get a trained person.
Most machine injuries are very serious and should be treated by a health worker right away.
Engine exhaust contains poisonous carbon monoxide: never run an engine indoors or without good ventilation.
Gasoline is highly flammable and explosive; stop the engine and let it cool before handling fuel.
The manufacturer says only qualified persons should install, operate, maintain and repair welding equipment.
Do not weld on containers that held combustibles, or closed tanks, drums or pipes, unless properly prepared to standards.
Only a licensed technician should turn natural gas back on after it has been shut off.
Installing flexible water and gas connections on a water heater: a licensed plumber is recommended and may be required.
These farm plans are conceptual, may not meet current codes, and do not replace competent design help.
You need training to use a crosscut saw; felling standing trees is more advanced and hazardous work.
